details.body:
List of the data tables as part of the Immigration system statistics Home Office release. Summary and detailed data tables covering the immigration system, including out-of-country and in-country visas, asylum, detention, and returns.

If you have any feedback, please email MigrationStatsEnquiries@homeoffice.gov.uk.

Accessible file formats

The Microsoft Excel .xlsx files may not be suitable for users of assistive technology.
If you use assistive technology (such as a screen reader) and need a version of these documents in a more accessible format, please email MigrationStatsEnquiries@homeoffice.gov.uk
Please tell us what format you need. It will help us if you say what assistive technology you use.

Related content

Immigration system statistics, year ending March 2026
Immigration system statistics quarterly release
Immigration system statistics user guide
Publishing detailed data tables in migration statistics
Policy and legislative changes affecting migration to the UK: timeline
Immigration statistics data archives

Passenger arrivals

Passenger arrivals summary tables, year ending June 2026 (ODS, 38.9 KB)

‘Passengers refused entry at the border summary tables’ and ‘Passengers refused entry at the border detailed datasets’ have been discontinued. The latest published versions of these tables are from February 2025 and are available in the ‘Passenger refusals – release discontinued’ section. A similar data series, ‘Refused entry at port and subsequently departed’, is available within the Returns detailed and summary tables.

Electronic travel authorisation

Electronic travel authorisation detailed datasets, year ending June 2026 (MS Excel Spreadsheet, 130 KB)
ETA_D01: Applications for electronic travel authorisations, by nationality  ETA_D02: Outcomes of applications for electronic travel authorisations, by nationality

Additional data relating to in country and overseas Visa applications can be found in the Migration transparency data collection, in the ‘Visas, Status and Immigration’ dataset.

Additional data relating to Citizenship and Windrush can be found in the Migration transparency data collection, in the ‘Passport, Citizenship and Civil Registration’, ‘Windrush Task Force’ and ‘Windrush Compensation Scheme’ datasets.

Immigration detention summary tables, year ending June 2026 (ODS, 79.4 KB)

Ret_D03: Number of foreign national offender returns from the UK, by nationality and return destination group
Ret_D04: Number of foreign national offender returns from the UK, by destination

Additional data relating to Sponsorship can be found in the Migration transparency data collection, in the ‘Sponsorship Transparency’ dataset.

Other migration and borders performance data

Additional data relating to migration and borders can be found in the Migration transparency data collection, including areas such as MP correspondence and applicant experience survey results, processing passport applications within service standards, General Register Office, unit cost per passenger processed at the border, seizures of commodities at the border (including high-harm commodities), and enforcement activities such as illegal working civil penalties.
